name: Open Graph
description: Social sharing previews for every published page: Open Graph and Twitter Card tags, a canonical link, and per-page meta descriptions. Derives everything from the page by default; every value can be overridden per page in the admin, or in bulk over the plugin's own API.

settings.label: Write social tags into published pages
settings.description: Off leaves every published page exactly as the platform rendered it. Turn it off to remove the tags again; nothing else in the site changes.

settings.label: Public address of the site
settings.description: The address people actually visit, with scheme and no trailing slash — https://www.drnahlah.com. Facebook, LinkedIn and X refuse a relative og:image and a relative og:url, so with this empty the plugin can emit no image and no canonical link at all.

settings.label: Site name
settings.description: og:site_name — the small label above the headline in a share card.

settings.label: Fallback share image
settings.description: Used on any page with no override and no picture of its own. A path from the media library (/uploads/...) or a full https:// address. 1200x630 is what every network crops to.

settings.label: Fallback share image, described
settings.description: og:image:alt for the fallback image. Read aloud by screen readers on the platforms that support it.

settings.label: Journal articles are og:type article
settings.description: On: anything published under a content table's route base (the 43 articles under /posts) is typed as an article rather than a website. That is what the type is for, and some readers show a byline and a date because of it.

settings.label: og:locale
settings.description: BCP-47 with an underscore, the way Open Graph writes it: en_US.

settings.label: X / Twitter account
settings.description: The practice's handle, with the @. Left empty, the twitter:site tag is omitted rather than emitted blank.

settings.label: Fill the gaps from the page itself
settings.description: On: a page with no override gets its title from its own <title>, its description from its SEO description, and its image from the first picture on the page. This is what makes the plugin useful on a 80-page site without anyone typing 80 sets of tags. Off: only pages with an explicit override get tags.

settings.label: Give each page its own meta description
settings.description: The platform emits ONE description on every page — the one in Site settings — because per-page SEO description is stored but never published. On, this replaces it with the page's own whenever one is known, so the description a search engine reads and the description a share card shows are the same sentence. Off leaves the site-wide one in place.

settings.label: Add a canonical link
settings.description: Adds <link rel="canonical"> pointing at the page's own address. Needs the public address above. Pages that already carry one are left alone.
